description: This file defines the Row class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, representing a row in a spreadsheet worksheet. It includes methods for retrieving row index, iterating over cells and columns, checking if a row is empty, and accessing the associated worksheet.

classes.name: Row
classes.description: Represents a row in a worksheet, providing methods for row management and iteration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the row with a parent worksheet and row index.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up the worksheet reference.

methods.name: getRowIndex
methods.description: Returns the index number of the row.

methods.name: getCellIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the cells in the row, starting from a specified column.

methods.name: getColumnIterator
methods.description: Synonym for getCellIterator, returns an iterator over columns in the row.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the row contains only empty cells based on specified criteria.

methods.name: getWorksheet
methods.description: Returns the worksheet object that this row belongs to.
